purpose: Read-only reconciliation of stabilization tool-feature inventory against checked-in generated client catalog and current source for discrepant mappings.

mapping_summary.matching_rule: Exact tool name plus exact inventory payload fields (input schema, permissions, admin flag, surface bundles and tier). Positional index is traceability only.

confidence.generated_catalog_vs_source: Moderate for the checked-in artifact: it has a generation timestamp later than inventory.updated_at and generator code derives entries from the source registry. This lane did not run generation, and timestamp does not prove source revision. Direct source schemas were checked for inject_stylesheet and stylesheet; both wait_for route schemas and ordering were checked; records server_catalog route was checked. Other schemas are compared at artifact level, not independently re-derived from source.
confidence.source_revision_alignment: Inventory source_sha is a historical commit older than current HEAD; it is recorded as provenance, not current-source proof.
confidence.live_binding: Inventory live_binding as_of is 2026-10-04T18:25:16Z. Historical metadata-query results do not prove live database binding state at capture time.

actionable_deltas.evidence: Current Zod schema contains css and optional tab_id; the handler calls insertCSS with those fields and does not read persist.
Current Zod schema has action inject/remove, css and optional tab_id; merger forwards css and tab_id to the leaf handlers.

actionable_deltas.current_name_index_rule: Use exact tool name and payload, not catalog_record_index, which is positional. The mapping array contains current candidate indices and exact payload-match indices per feature.

scope_notes: No database, browser, tests, build, catalog generation, secrets, or product/inventory edits were used.
No parameter, feature, or runtime status was removed or promoted in the authoritative inventory.
records remains a server execution capability in the Tools view and is intentionally outside the generated client schema catalog.
wait_for retains two distinct feature IDs and two current catalog records; the inventory row IDs were not collapsed.
